name: RHYME TIME
scope: Every answer is a rhyming pair of words meaning the clue.

clues.q: A house pet of the feline sort, carrying rather too much weight
A very amusing rabbit
A small insect settled comfortably in a woven floor covering
A clever and thought-provoking piece of painting or sculpture
A male duck baking a sweet thing in the oven

name: STUPID ANSWERS
scope: Every answer is a word sitting in plain sight inside the clue. Say it out loud and you have said the answer.

clues.q: The colour named in the name of the Black Sea
The material a solid brick wall is built out of
The number of wheels on a standard two-wheeled bicycle
The shape the Pentagon building is built in
The continent the African elephant is native to

name: CROSSWORD CLUES "A"
scope: Every answer begins with A and is clued the way a crossword would clue it.

clues.q: First of the twelve months, alphabetically speaking
Orchard fruit with a reputation for keeping the doctor away
Take a child into the family as your own
A gulf so deep it seems to have no bottom at all
One who works for the good of others at cost to themselves

name: COMMON BONDS
scope: Every answer is the thing three named items have in common.

clues.q: A comb, a saw, a zipper
A needle, a hurricane, a potato
A river, a cave, a bottle
A tree, a dog, a seal
A table, a journey, a trouser

name: ANAGRAMS
scope: Every answer is the word the clued letters rearrange into, and so is every wrong option.

clues.q: The letters of SILENT, rearranged into what you do with your ears
The letters of DANGER, rearranged into somewhere things grow
The letters of SECURE, rearranged into what the lifeboat does
The letters of TEACHER, rearranged into somebody who wins dishonestly
The letters of TRIANGLE, rearranged into a whole number, or the heart of a calculus problem

name: ODD ONE OUT
scope: Every answer is the one item in a list that does not belong.

clues.q: Apple, banana, carrot, grape
Venus, Mars, Apollo, Jupiter
Oxygen, gold, silver, iron
Piano, violin, cello, viola
George, John, Thomas, Benjamin
The decade Apollo 11 put the first people on the Moon
The decade the Titanic went down on her maiden voyage
The decade the Berlin Wall came down
The decade the Soviet Union dissolved into independent republics
The decade the United States took the dollar off gold at home

name: STARTS & ENDS
scope: Every answer is a word starting and ending with the same letters.

clues.q: A fabric shelter held up with poles and ropes
A great bird of prey that a good many countries put on their arms
The instrument that finds aircraft and storms with radio waves
Where outpatients are seen and treated
The building that keeps what a culture does not want to lose

name: HOMOPHONES
scope: Every answer is one of a pair of words that sound alike and are spelt differently.

clues.q: The unit a diamond is weighed in
A ceremony performed the same way every time
The African antelope also called a wildebeest
The little wedge a proofreader draws to show something is missing
The Dane whose model of the atom won the 1922 Nobel Prize in Physics

name: PALINDROMES
scope: Every answer reads the same backwards.

clues.q: A narrow boat driven along with a double-bladed paddle
The spinning blades that hold a helicopter up
A principle held as true by a faith or a philosophy
What the British call a half note
Made a god of

name: QUOTABLE QUOTES
scope: Every answer is who said a famous line.

clues.q: "I have a dream that my four little children will one day live in a nation where they will not be judged by the color of their skin"
"That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind"
"Speak softly and carry a big stick; you will go far"
"I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds"
"The report of my death was an exaggeration"

name: ALSO KNOWN AS
scope: Every answer is a real name behind a stage name, or the other way round.

clues.q: The name on Marilyn Monroe's birth certificate
The name Muhammad Ali was born with and gave up in 1964
The Missouri man who signed his books Mark Twain
The Budapest-born escapologist who performed as Harry Houdini
The name Coco Chanel was christened with

name: ALPHABET SOUP
scope: Every answer is what an abbreviation stands for, or the abbreviation itself.

clues.q: The U in the UN
The scan whose three letters are MRI
The O in OPEC
The N in NATO
The S in LASER

name: FOREIGN PHRASES
scope: Every answer is a foreign phrase used in English, or its meaning.

clues.q: The Latin for seize the day
The French for the feeling that this has all happened before
The Spanish goodbye that English borrowed for a final one
The German word English took for pleasure at another's misfortune
The Latin a diplomat is declared when a country wants them gone
